decisions.reason: Chinese 欽哀 is Qin'ai; Qintian misreads 哀 as tian. The proposed Empress Dowager Qin'ai restores the correct temple-name reading without changing the rest of the sentence.
The literal field likewise renders 欽哀 as Qintian; Qin'ai is the accurate pinyin, and the rest of the literal rendering matches 與欽哀有隙 / 欽哀密令安仁.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 仁德皇后與欽哀有隙，欽哀密令安仁

decisions.reason: In 仁德欲誅之，欽哀以言營救 the intercessor is 欽哀 (Qin'ai), not Qintian; the proposed swap corrects the name only.
Same unit: 欽哀 is Qin'ai; replacing Qintian in the literal line is a real transliteration fix, not a stylistic change.
重熙初，欽哀攝政 names the regent as 欽哀 (Qin'ai); Empress Dowager Qintian is a mistransliteration, and the proposed Empress Dowager Qin'ai is accurate.
The literal likewise misreads 欽哀 as Qintian; Qin'ai correctly names the regent who 欲廢帝，立少子重元.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 欽哀攝政，欲廢帝，立少子重元

claimRevisions.reason: The English title Empress Dowager Qintian came only from the bad idiomatic rendering of 欽哀; accepting r0005 restores Empress Dowager Qin'ai while the 太后 title fact remains.
